items.name: uiception/stats-section-v6
items.title: Stats Section v6
items.description: A support stats section with a bento grid of waffle charts. The left column has the title and description. The right column has one tile per support channel, sized by rank, with its share, wait time, and a small 10 by 10 grid. Each grid lights only that channel's squares, in the same spots they hold in the full 100, so the four grids add up to one chart. The two smallest channels show only the two rows that hold their squares, drawn at full tile width so they read at the same scale as the others. Lit squares fill in on load, then breathe in a slow diagonal shimmer. Static data, no API.

items.name: shadcn-ui-blocks/portfolio-portfolio-event-speaking-and-workshops-event-cards-grid
items.title: Event Cards Grid
items.description: A grid of cards listing talks and workshops with their title, date, and venue. Use it to present many speaking appearances in one scannable layout.

items.name: shadcn-ui-blocks/ecommerce-product-features-features-testimonial-combo
items.title: Features Testimonial Combo
items.description: A layout that pairs product features with a customer quote beside them. Backs each benefit claim with real proof to win hesitant buyers over.

items.name: shadcn-ui-blocks/marketing-subscribe-input-style
items.title: Input Style
items.description: A compact email input with an inline submit button on one row. Drop it into a footer or banner where space is tight but you still want signups.

items.name: shadcn-ui-blocks/application-application-stats-simple-cards
items.title: Simple Cards
items.description: Clean metric cards that display a label and a single number set side by side. Use across a dashboard header to surface key totals at a glance.

items.name: shadcn-ui-blocks/marketing-cta-sections-newsletter-form
items.title: Newsletter Form
items.description: A signup section with an email input and subscribe button under a short pitch. Collects leads for a newsletter, waitlist, or product updates.

items.name: shadcn-ui-blocks/ecommerce-shopping-cart-sidebar-cart
items.title: Sidebar Cart
items.description: A cart that slides in from the side as a panel over the page, listing items and totals. Keeps shopping in view while customers adjust quantities and pay.

items.name: shadcn-ui-blocks/marketing-stats-funnel-stats
items.title: Funnel Stats
items.description: A stepped funnel showing how many visitors move from view to signup to paid. Use it to explain conversion and where users drop off in your flow.

items.name: shadcn-ui-blocks/ecommerce-product-features-split-image-features
items.title: Split Image Features
items.description: A two column section with a product photo on one side and feature copy on the other. Balances visual and text to sell a single hero capability.

items.name: shadcn-ui-blocks/marketing-testimonials-base
items.title: Base
items.description: A clean testimonial section with a customer quote, name, role, and avatar. Drop it onto any landing page to add a trusted voice with little effort.

items.name: shadcn-ui-blocks/marketing-about-sections-press-recognitions
items.title: Press & Recognitions
items.description: A strip of publication logos and pull quotes that show where you have been featured. Use it on an about page to borrow trust from known names.

items.name: shadcn-ui-blocks/marketing-careers-department-showcase
items.title: Department Showcase
items.description: A department showcase with cards describing each team, its focus, and people. Helps candidates understand where they fit before browsing open roles.

items.name: shadcn-ui-blocks/marketing-team-sections-with-large-images
items.title: With Large Images
items.description: Team profiles built around big, full bleed portraits with name and role. Puts faces front and center for a bold, personal about page that feels human.

items.name: shadcn-ui-blocks/portfolio-portfolio-process-and-approach-stacked-cards
items.title: Stacked Cards
items.description: A vertical stack of cards, each describing one phase of your process in turn. Use it to walk a client through how an engagement unfolds step by step.
